blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In real-world clinical settings, dental X-ray segmentation using deep learning methods suffers from reliability issues. Even when the segmentation quality is bad, deep learning models show high confidence in their predictions (calibrational blindness). Moreover, in real use, doctors do not have ground-truth masks to check their accuracy. To address this problem, we introduce a simple quality-checking engine called HUS-QA with three stages. We train it on the PRAD (Periapical Dental X-ray) dataset to build our SimCLR self-supervised ResNet-18 U-Net model, which generates the segmentation mask and then evaluates its quality. Our HUS-QA checks the segmentation mask quality without a ground-truth mask. Prediction confidence, edge sharpness, shape connectivity, and area-size penalty are the simple indicators considered in this research. Results show that standard confidence methods fail (r = -0.1394, p = 1.7864e-3, ROC AUC = 0.4275). By contrast, our HUS-QA shows a positive correlation with actual Dice scores (r = 0.4647, p = 3.7510e-28) and achieves a strong ROC-AUC of 0.8405. Therefore, HUS-QA serves as a practical tool for clinical quality control.
blocks.zh: 在现实世界的临床环境中,使用深层学习方法进行牙科X射线分解有可靠性问题. 即使分化质量不佳,深层学习模型也表现出对其预测(校正失明)的高度信心. 此外,在实际使用中,医生没有地面真实的口罩来检查其准确性。 为了解决这个问题,我们采用了一个名为HUS-QA的简单质量检查引擎,分三个阶段. 我们在PRAD(Periapical Dental X-ray)数据集上对其进行培训,以构建我们的SimCLR自控的ResNet-18 U-Net模型,该模型生成分解口罩并随后评价其质量. 我们的HUS -QA检查 分解口罩的质量 没有地面真实口罩。 预测性自信,边缘锐度,外形连通性,和面积大小的判罚是本研究中考虑的简单指标. 结果显示,标准置信方法失败(r=-0.1394,p=1.7864e-3,ROC AUC=0.4275)。 相形之下,我们的HUS-QA显示与实际的Dice分数(r = 0.4647,p = 3.7510e-28)呈正相关,并实现了0.8405的ROC-AUC强势. 因此,HUS-QA是临床质量控制的实用工具.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: In modern medical systems, automatically segmenting dental X-rays is essential, as it helps clinicians diagnose oral conditions [ 1 , 2 ] . Deep learning models, especially encoder-decoder models [ 3 ] , help doctors detect oral diseases and save time by segmenting different dental anatomical structures in images [ 4 ] . But in real-world use, calibrational blindness is a major problem. Deep learning models often show high confidence even when their output masks are wrong or incomplete [ 5 ] . After deployment, clinicians have no labels to check whether the masks generated by deep learning models are reliable or misleading [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 在现代医疗系统中,自动分解牙科X光至关重要,因为它有助于临床医生诊断口腔状况[1,2]. 深层学习模型,特别是编码器-解码器模型[3],通过将图像中不同的牙科解剖结构分解来帮助医生发现口腔疾病并节省时间[4]. 但在现实世界的使用中,校正失明是一个主要问题. 深层学习模型即使其输出口罩出错或不完整,也往往表现出很高的信心 [5]. 部署后,临床医生没有标签来检查深层学习模型产生的口罩是否可靠或误导 [6].

blocks.en: We need a quality-control framework that can assess predicted mask quality without ground truth to build trust in Medical AI tools [ 6 , 7 ] . Standard quality checks only look at basic confidence scores, but high confidence does not guarantee good shape or structure [ 5 ] . To solve this issue, we present the Heuristic Unsupervised Quality Assurance (HUS-QA) engine. By looking at four simple visual indicators such as confidence score, boundary sharpness, component connectivity, and anatomical area size, HUS-QA checks the segmentation quality of X-rays. It combines these indicators into one final score to tell doctors if a mask needs manual checking. Also, to lower the cost of expert annotations, our framework uses Self-Supervised Learning (SimCLR) to learn features from unannotated X-ray images first [ 8 , 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们需要一个质量控制框架,能够评估没有底线的预期口罩质量,以建立对医疗AI工具的信任[6,7]. 标准质量检查只看基本信心分数,而高信心并不能保证良好的形状或结构[5]. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了Heuristic无监督质量保证(HUS-QA)引擎. HUS-QA通过查看信心分数,边界锐度,组件连通性,解剖区域大小等四个简单的视觉指标,检查了X射线的分化质量. 它将这些指标合并为一个最终分数,告诉医生一个口罩是否需要人工检查. 此外,为了降低专家说明的成本,我们的框架使用自我监督学习(SimCLR)首先从无注释的X射线图像中学习特征[8,9].

blocks.en: The primary contributions of this work are: • We present HUS-QA, a simple approach that checks dental segmentation quality and catches overconfident errors without using ground-truth masks. • We combine basic confidence scores with structural signals like Sobel edge sharpness, shape connectivity, and area penalties. • We use a SimCLR self-supervised ResNet-18 [ 10 ] U-Net model on the PRAD dataset to get good segmentation results with fewer labeled images. • Test results show that HUS-QA has a positive correlation with Dice scores ( r = 0.4647 r=0.4647 , p = 3.7510 × 10 − 28 p=3.7510\times 10^{-28} ) and yields a strong ROC-AUC of 0.8405 0.8405 for separating bad segmentations, which is significantly better than standard confidence methods ( − 0.1394 -0.1394 , ROC-AUC = 0.4275 \text{ROC-AUC}=0.4275 ).
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献是: 我们提出HUS-QA,这是一种简单的方法,在不使用地面真实口罩的情况下检查牙科分解质量并发现过度自信的错误。 我们把基本信心分数与索贝尔边缘锐度,外形连通性,和地区罚等结构信号结合起来. ^ 在PRAD数据集上,我们使用一个SimCLR自我监督的ResNet-18 [10] U-Net模型,以获得良好的分解结果并减少被标记的图像. ^ 测试结果显示,HUS-QA与Dice分数(r=0.4647 r=0.4647,p=3.7510×10-28p=3.7510\times 10^{-28})有正相关,并产生强烈的ROC-AUC为0.84050.8405,用于分离不良分数,这明显优于标准置信方法(-0.1394-0.1394,ROC-AUC=0.4275\text{ROC-AUC=0.4275).

blocks.en: We present HUS-QA, a simple approach that checks dental segmentation quality and catches overconfident errors without using ground-truth masks.
blocks.zh: 我们提出HUS-QA,一种简单的方法,检查牙科分片质量,发现过度自信的错误,而不使用地上真假口罩.

blocks.en: Test results show that HUS-QA has a positive correlation with Dice scores ( r = 0.4647 r=0.4647 , p = 3.7510 × 10 − 28 p=3.7510\times 10^{-28} ) and yields a strong ROC-AUC of 0.8405 0.8405 for separating bad segmentations, which is significantly better than standard confidence methods ( − 0.1394 -0.1394 , ROC-AUC = 0.4275 \text{ROC-AUC}=0.4275 ).

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Deep Learning in Dental Radiography
blocks.zh: II-A 牙科放射学深造

blocks.en: In medical image segmentation, convolutional neural networks such as U-Net models [ 3 ] are standard AI tools [ 4 ] . Deep learning methods are widely used for tooth segmentation, cancer detection, caries detection, and anatomical structure analysis in the dental sector [ 1 , 2 ] . However, training traditional supervised models requires a huge amount of pixel-level annotated data from experts, which is time-consuming and expensive.
blocks.zh: 在医学图像分解中,U-Net模型等革命神经网络[3]是标准的AI工具[4]. 深入的学习方法被广泛用于牙齿分化,癌症检测,小鹿检测,以及牙科部门的解剖结构分析[1,2]. 然而,培训传统监督模型需要专家提供大量像素级附加注释的数据,这既费时又昂贵.

blocks.en: II-B Self-Supervised Learning in Medical AI
blocks.zh: II-B 医学AI的自我监督学习

blocks.en: The problem of labeled data scarcity can be solved by Self-Supervised Learning (SSL). Contrastive methods like SimCLR [ 8 ] learn useful features from unlabeled images by pulling the two augmented views of a single image close together in feature space, while pushing views from other images further apart. The segmentation quality can be improved by SSL pre-trained models when labeled data is small in size [ 9 , 7 ] . Additionally, recent studies show that self-supervised learning has performed well in learning features without manual labeling in medical imaging [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 被贴上标签的数据稀缺问题可以通过自我监督学习(SSL)来解决. SimCLR等相矛盾的方法[8]从无标签的图像中学习出有用的特征,在特征空间中将单个图像的两种放大视图拉近,同时将其他图像的视角推向更远. 当被贴上标签的数据尺寸小于[9,7]时,可以通过SSL预训模型来改进分解质量. 此外,最近的研究表明,自我监督的学习在学习特征方面表现良好,没有在医学成像中手工标注[11].

blocks.en: II-C Quality Control and Calibrational Blindness
blocks.zh: II-C 质量控制和校准盲度

blocks.en: Deep neural networks can show high confidence even if they do not predict correctly. They frequently give very high confidence on noisy data [ 5 ] . In real medical systems, calibrational blindness can be risky for human beings. To check the prediction quality of models without ground truth, Valindria et al. have proposed reverse classification accuracy (RCA) [ 6 ] . Calculating model uncertainty is used by other methods to predict segmentation quality [ 12 ] or fix calibration issues [ 13 ] . On the other hand, using uncertainty estimation methods can be slower or heavier in real-time use. Therefore, shape rules and boundary metrics can be used to identify bad outputs without heavy uncertainty estimation. Moving forward with the concept, our HUS-QA engine combines confidence, edge sharpness, connectivity, and area limits into a simple framework which is designed to address dental segmentation errors and assess the quality of the segmentation.
blocks.zh: 深神经网络即使没有正确的预测,也能表现出很高的信心. 他们经常对吵闹的数据非常有信心 [5]. 在真正的医疗系统中,校正失明可能对人类有风险. 为了检查无地真能模型的预测质量,瓦林德里亚等提出了反向分类精度(RCA)[6]. 计算模型不确定性被其他方法用来预测分化质量[12]或固定校正问题[13]. 另一方面,使用不确定性估计方法在实时使用中可能较慢或更重. 因此,可以使用形状规则和边界指标来识别差的输出,而不进行重大的不确定性估计. 推进这个概念,我们的HUS-QA引擎将信心、边缘锐度、连通性和面积限制结合起来,形成一个简单的框架,旨在解决牙科分化错误并评估分化的质量。

blocks.en: Research Gap. Some methods can check segmentation quality without ground truth, for example, reverse classification accuracy [ 6 ] and uncertainty-based methods [ 12 , 13 ] . But these were mostly made for general medical images. As per our knowledge, it remains untested whether a model’s confidence can be trusted as a quality score on dental X-rays, although overconfidence is a known problem [ 5 ] . Our results show that this is a real problem. On periapical X-rays, confidence does not follow segmentation quality (AUC = 0.4275), and a nearly empty mask can still get 99.96% confidence (Fig. 5 , Case C). So we propose HUS-QA, a simple quality check that does not need ground-truth masks.
blocks.zh: 研究差距。 有些方法可以在没有地基真理的情况下检查分化质量,例如倒向分类精度[6]和基于不确定性的方法[12,13]. 但是这些主要是为一般的医疗图像而制作的. 据我们所知,一个模型的信心能否作为牙科X光的质量得分而被信任,尽管过度自信是一个已知的问题[5],但仍没有得到检验。 我们的结果显示,这是一个真正的问题。 在近地X光上,置信度不跟随分解质量(AUC = 0.4275),而一个几乎是空的口罩仍然可以得到99.96%的置信度(图5, Case C). 因此,我们提议HUS-QA,一个简单的质量检查,不需要地面真实口罩.

blocks.en: III Methodology
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: The full design of our three-stage framework is shown in Fig. 1 . It works as an automatic quality assurance system using the PRAD dataset. During testing, a periapical dental X-ray is first pre-processed and sent through the SimCLR-initialized ResNet-18 [ 10 ] U-Net to produce a tooth mask. Next, the HUS-QA module checks the output reliability without ground-truth masks and gives a quality score to help doctors accept or reject the result.
blocks.zh: 我们三个阶段框架的全部设计如图1所示。 它作为一个使用PRAD数据集的自动质量保证系统发挥作用. 在测试期间,先先先进行外侧口腔口腔X光预处理,再通过SimCLR-初始化的ResNet-18 [10] U-Net来生产出牙口罩. 接下来,HUS-QA模块在没有地面真实口罩的情况下检查输出可靠性,并给出质量分数来帮助医生接受或拒绝结果.

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Overall framework of the SimCLR ResNet-18 U-Net segmentation and HUS-QA quality check pipeline.
blocks.zh: 发相. 1:SimCLR ResNet-18 U-Net分块和HUS-QA质量检查管道的总体框架.

blocks.en: III-A Dataset Setup and Data Splitting:
blocks.zh: 数据集设置和数据分割:

blocks.en: We evaluated our system (HUS-QA) on PRAD dataset with separate data splits for self-supervised pre-training and supervised training tasks. At first, we performed self-supervised feature learning using 2,500 2,500 unlabeled X-ray images in Stage 1. For Stage 2, the labeled dataset was split into three sets. These three sets were 1,750 1,750 image-mask pairs for training, 250 250 pairs for validation, and 500 500 pairs for final testing.
blocks.zh: 我们在PRAD数据集上评价了我们的系统(HUS-QA),对自我监督的预训和被监督的培训任务分别进行了数据分解. 起初,我们在第一阶段使用2500,500个无标签的X射线图像进行自控特性学习. 对于第二阶段,标有标签的数据集被分作三套. 这三套是1,750个1,750个图像掩模对用于培训,250个对用于验证,500个对用于最终测试.

blocks.en: III-B Stage 1: Pre-processing and Self-Supervised Learning:
blocks.zh: 三-B阶段 1: 预处理和自我监督 学习:

blocks.en: Image Pre-processing: At first, we converted dental X-rays into grayscale and enhanced them with CLAHE where the clip limit is 2.0 2.0 , and the tile grid is 8 × 8 8\times 8 to make details clearer. Then images were saved as 3-channel RGB and resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 pixels.
blocks.zh: 图像预处理 : 一开始,我们把牙科X光转换为灰度并用CLAHE增强,其中剪接限制为2.0 2.0,而平板格为8×8 8\times 8,以更清晰的细节. 随后图像被保存为3道RGB并被调整为224×224\times 224像素.

blocks.en: SimCLR Augmentations: Each image was transformed into two views using random crops ( scale = 0.6 ​ – ​ 1.0 \text{scale}=0.6\text{--}1.0 ), horizontal flips ( p = 0.5 p=0.5 ), brightness adjustments ( p = 0.8 p=0.8 ), ImageNet normalization, and Gaussian noise ( p = 0.3 , σ = 0.05 p=0.3,\sigma=0.05 ).
blocks.zh: SimCLR 数据 扩增:每个图像被转换成两个视图,使用随机收成(比例=0.6 – 1.0\text{scale\0.6\text{-}1.0),水平翻转(p=0.5 p=0.5),亮度调整(p=0.8 p=0.8),ImageNet正常化,高斯噪音(p=0.3,\=0.03,\sigma=0.05).

blocks.en: III-C Stage 2: Dental segmentation initiated by Self-Supervised Learning:
blocks.zh: 三-C阶段 2:自我监督学习发起的牙科分化:

blocks.en: The pre-trained SimCLR ResNet-18 encoder was used as the encoder of a U-Net architecture for supervised dental segmentation. We applied standard medical preprocessing, including CLAHE, to all input images to enhance boundary clarity and resized them to 224 × 224 224\times 224 pixels. The SimCLR self-supervised ResNet-18 U-Net model was trained on 1,750 1,750 paired images and masks, with model selection guided by the 250 250 validation pairs. For 25 training epochs, the model received paired data augmentation in the form of random horizontal flipping and rotation ( ± 15 ∘ \pm 15^{\circ} ).
blocks.zh: 预训的SimCLR ResNet-18编码器被用作U-Net架构的编码器,用于监督牙科分解. 我们对所有输入图像应用包括CLAHE在内的标准医疗预处理,以提高边界清晰度并调整到224×224/224\times 224像素. SimCLR 自我监督的ResNet-18 U-Net模型接受了1,750个1,750个配对图像和口罩的培训,模型选择由250个验证对来指导. 对于25个训练时代,该模型以随机水平翻转和旋转的形式获得了配对数据增强(±15 →\pm 15 →\circ}).

where λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 . The AdamW optimizer with cosine annealing learning-rate scheduling was used to train the network. The model, which achieved the highest validation Dice score on the validation set, was selected for the subsequent quality assessment stage.

blocks.en: III-D Stage 3: Proposed Ground-Truth-Free Segmentation Quality Assessment (HUS-QA):
blocks.zh: 三-D 第3阶段:拟议的无地裂解质量评估:

blocks.en: Without relying on ground-truth annotations, the proposed HUS-QA module assesses the predicted segmentations across 500 500 test samples. To estimate overall reliability, it analyzes both the soft prediction confidences and the corresponding binary masks.
blocks.zh: 拟议的HUS-QA模块没有依赖地面真实说明,而是评估了500个测试样本的预测分块。 为了估计总体可靠性,它同时分析软预测置信度和相应的二进制口罩.

blocks.en: Four complementary quality indicators are extracted: • Prediction Confidence ( Q c Q_{c} ): Computed from the confidence distribution of the predicted soft mask. • Boundary Sharpness ( Q s Q_{s} ): Estimated using the Sobel gradient magnitude of the predicted segmentation boundaries. • Structural Connectivity ( Q str Q_{\text{str}} ): Measured from the connected components of the binary segmentation mask to penalize fragmented or isolated predictions. • Anatomical Area Consistency ( Q area Q_{\text{area}} ): An area penalty factor to suppress anatomically unrealistic segmentation regions.
blocks.zh: 提取了四个补充质量指标: • 预测信任(问题c-Q-C}): 由预测出软口罩的置信分布所计算出. • 边界锐度(Q s Q_{s}): 使用预测分界的索贝尔梯度等值进行估计。 • 结构连接(Q strtext{str}}}): 从二元分解口罩的相接部分来测量,以惩罚零碎或孤立的预测. • 解剖区一致性(Q区 QText{Area}): 抑制解剖不切实际的分化区域的一个地区惩罚因素。

blocks.en: Prediction Confidence ( Q c Q_{c} ): Computed from the confidence distribution of the predicted soft mask.
blocks.zh: 预测信任(Q c QQc}): 由预测出软口罩的置信分配所计算出.

blocks.en: Boundary Sharpness ( Q s Q_{s} ): Estimated using the Sobel gradient magnitude of the predicted segmentation boundaries.
blocks.zh: 边界锐度( Q s {s} ): 使用预测分界的索贝尔梯度等值进行估计。

blocks.en: Structural Connectivity ( Q str Q_{\text{str}} ): Measured from the connected components of the binary segmentation mask to penalize fragmented or isolated predictions.

blocks.en: IV Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 四. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: IV-A Segmentation Performance
blocks.zh: 四-A 分块业绩

blocks.en: We used 500 500 test images from the PRAD dataset to evaluate the SimCLR ResNet-18 U-Net model. As reported in Table I , the model acquired an Accuracy of 0.9872 0.9872 , a Dice Score of 0.6961 0.6961 , and an IoU (Jaccard) of 0.5666 0.5666 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用了来自PRAD数据集的500500个测试图像来评价SimCLR ResNet-18 U-Net模型. 如表一所报告,该型号获得的精确度为:0.9872 0.9872;二分分数为:0.6961 0.6961;一分数为:0.5666 0.5666。

blocks.en: We intentionally did not try to improve the segmentation model to perfection. Instead, we wanted to test our HUS-QA engine on challenging and imperfect masks. This proves that our QA engine can successfully detect and measure errors even when the segmentation model makes mistakes.
blocks.zh: 我们故意不试图改进分解模式,使之完美。 相反,我们想测试我们的HUS -QA引擎 具有挑战性和不完善的口罩。 这证明我们的QA引擎即使在分解模型出错时也能成功检测并测量出出错误.

blocks.en: IV-B 1 Baseline Quality Assessment

blocks.en: Fig. 2 illustrates the performance of the baseline confidence-based quality assessment method on the test set. We considered a segmentation acceptable when its Dice score reached 70 % 70\% or higher, following the literature [ 14 , 15 ] . This cutoff was used to label samples as acceptable or poor for the ROC-AUC analysis in Fig. 2 and Fig. 3 . The scatter plot reveals a weak negative correlation ( r = − 0.1394 , p = 1.7864 × 10 − 3 r=-0.1394,p=1.7864\times 10^{-3} ) with the ground-truth Dice score. The corresponding ROC curve yields an AUC of only 0.4275 0.4275 , performing worse than random guessing ( AUC = 0.50 \text{AUC}=0.50 ). This happens because of how the model behaves when it predicts nothing. As Fig. 5 (Case C) shows, when the model predicts an almost empty mask, its confidence stays very high, since the sigmoid values are close to zero across the whole image. So even the worst predictions can get high confidence scores. This is why the correlation turns negative, and the AUC ends up below random guessing.
blocks.zh: 图2说明了测试组基准信任质量评估方法的绩效。 我们认为,根据文献[14、15],当Dice的分数达到70%或更高时,这种分化是可以接受的。 这一截断用于将样品标注为ROC-AUC分析在图2和图3中可以接受或差。 散出情节揭示出一种弱的负相关(r = − 0.1394,p = 1.7864 × 10 – 3 r =-0.1394,p = 1.7864\times 10 = 3 }),地-地-地-地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地: 相应的ROC曲线产生的AUC只有0.4275 0.4275,表现比随机猜测更糟糕(AUC=0.50\text{AUC}=0.50. 这之所以发生,是因为模型在预测无所事事时的表现. 如Fig. 5(Case C)所显示,当模型预测出一个几乎是空的面具时,它的置信度会保持非常高,因为相模值在整个图像上接近于零. 因此,即使是最糟糕的预测也能得到高信任分. 这就是为什么关联性变为负值,AUC最终低于随机猜测.

blocks.en: Fig. 3 highlights the evaluation of the proposed HUS-QA engine. HUS-QA showed a positive correlation with actual Dice scores ( r = 0.4647 r=0.4647 ), with a very small p p -value ( p = 3.7510 × 10 − 28 p=3.7510\times 10^{-28} ). The ROC curve gives a strong AUC of 0.8405 0.8405 , which is much better than the baseline AUC of 0.4275 0.4275 . Integrating edge sharpness, connectivity, and anatomical area constraints allows HUS-QA to reliably diagnose faulty outputs without ground truth.

blocks.en: IV-C Threshold Sensitivity Analysis
blocks.zh: IV-C 临界敏感度分析

blocks.en: In our main evaluation, we considered a segmentation acceptable when its Dice score reached 70 % 70\% or higher. To check that this specific cutoff does not bias the reported results, we recomputed the ROC-AUC for both the baseline QA method and the proposed HUS-QA across a range of thresholds (0.60 to 0.80). Table III shows the results.
blocks.zh: 在我们的主要评价中,我们认为,如果分化是可以接受的, 虱分达到70% 70分以上. 为了检查这一具体截断是否不偏向所报告的结果,我们重新计算了基线质量保证法和拟议的高频-质量法的ROC-AUC的阈值(0.60至0.80)。 表三显示结果。

blocks.en: The AUC of HUS-QA stays close to 0.82–0.84 across all thresholds tested, even though the class balance changes considerably (from 390:110 at 0.60 to 157:343 at 0.80). This suggests the reported performance is not tied to the specific 0.7 cutoff. The baseline QA method stays weak at every threshold, with AUC ranging from 0.3461 to 0.5506 – close to random guessing (AUC = 0.50) and far below HUS-QA at all points tested.

blocks.en: IV-D Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 四-D 定性分析

blocks.en: Fig. 5 provides a visual comparison across three qualitative regimes. For high-quality segmentations (Case A), the predicted mask aligns closely with anatomical boundaries, giving high Dice and HUS-QA scores. In moderate failure cases (Case B), HUS-QA scores drop considerably due to severe under-segmentation and anatomical area loss. In severe failure cases (Case C), HUS-QA produces very low scores, marking these predictions for clinician audit. Conversely, the baseline confidence score remains uncalibrated, yielding high confidence values across all failure modes.
blocks.zh: 图5提供了三种定性制度的可视比较。 对于高品质分解(Case A),所预想的口罩与解剖边界紧密相接,给出了高得分和HUS-QA分数. 在中度故障(案件B)中,HUS-QA的分数因严重分数不足和解剖区损失而大幅下降. 在严重故障的情况下(C号案件),HUS-QA的分数非常低,标志着临床医生审计的这些预测。 反之,基线信心分数仍没有校正,在所有失败模式中产生高信心值。

blocks.en: IV-E Discussion
blocks.zh: 四-E 讨论

blocks.en: Our findings confirm that incorporating structural, boundary, and geometrical priors addresses calibrational blindness in deep learning segmentations without reference masks. HUS-QA exhibits superior correlation ( r = 0.4647 r=0.4647 ) compared to naive confidence ( r = − 0.1394 r=-0.1394 ), providing a reliable safeguard for automated dental radiography diagnostics. Although we tested our method only on the PRAD dataset, HUS-QA uses basic shape and edge rules. These general rules do not depend on a specific dataset, so the method may also work for other types of medical images.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果证实,纳入结构、边界和几何前科可以解决在没有参考口罩的深层学习分区中的校正失明问题。 与天真自信(r = − 0.1394 r =-0.1394)相比,HUS-QA表现出了优越的关联性(r = 0.4647 r = 0.4647),为自动牙科射线诊断提供了可靠的保障. 虽然我们只在PRAD数据集上测试了我们的方法,HUS-QA使用基本的形状和边缘规则. 这些通则并不依赖于特定的数据集,因此该方法也可能适用于其他类型的医学图像.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: This study proposed HUS-QA, an unsupervised quality assurance framework designed to detect overconfident segmentation errors in dental AI workflows. Evaluated on dental X-rays, HUS-QA synthesizes confidence, boundary sharpness, structural connectivity, and anatomical constraints without ground-truth masks. The framework achieves a moderate Pearson correlation with actual Dice scores ( r = 0.4647 , p = 3.7510 × 10 − 28 r=0.4647,p=3.7510\times 10^{-28} ) and an ROC AUC of 0.8405 0.8405 , outperforming standard confidence baselines ( r = − 0.1394 , ROC AUC = 0.4275 r=-0.1394,\text{ROC AUC}=0.4275 ).
blocks.zh: 这项研究提出了HUS-QA,这是一个无监督的质量保证框架,旨在发现牙科AI工作流程中的过度自信分化错误. 对牙科X光进行评估后,HUS-QA综合了信心,边界锐度,结构连通性,以及解剖限制,没有地上真伪口罩. 该框架与实际的Dice分数(r=0.4647,p=3.7510×10-28 r=0.4647,p=3.7510\times 10^{-28})和ROC AUC为0.84050.8405,表现优于标准信任基线(r=−0.1394,ROC AUC=0.4275 r=-0.1394,\text{ROC AUC=0.4275}实现了中度的皮尔逊关联.

blocks.en: As mentioned in Section IV-A, we chose a moderately performing model on purpose to test HUS-QA under difficult conditions. In future work, we plan to test HUS-QA on a better-performing U-Net to see if it still works well when segmentation quality is high. We also plan to extend the indicator set and test HUS-QA on panoramic radiographs and 3D CBCT imaging techniques.
blocks.zh: 如第四节A分节所述,我们选择了一种性能中度的模式,目的是在困难的条件下测试HUS-QA。 在未来的工作中,我们计划测试HUS-QA的优异性能的U-Net,看看在分解质量高的时候它是否仍然有效. 我们还计划扩大指标集,并测试全景放射图和3D CBCT成像技术的HUS-QA.
